# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need convey the manual to Deaf without speech. I’ll use the obvious numbered hand signs: ☝ = first, ✌ = second, 🤟 = third. The table’s listed light colours are in order green, red, yellow, and the required cut-wire positions are second, third, first. I’ll send the three ordered pairs, with 👌 separating each pair.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "👌", "✌", "🤟", "👌", "🤟", "☝"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and coordinate with Deaf. Ask Deaf to report the display, light, and wire colours or markings to you, then tell me exactly which wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb view: display 0; light green; wires 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red. I saw your gestures: pointing up, victory, OK, victory, I love you, OK, I love you, pointing up. Blind signaled a wave.

The light is green, so the manual requires cutting the red wire. Deaf reports that the red wire is in position 3. I will confirm the required wire position to Deaf; however, under the stated communication limits, I have no direct channel to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, green light, and wires: position 1 yellow, position 2 green, position 3 red. Which wire does the manual require me to cut?

The manual maps green light to the red wire. Deaf identified the red wire as position 3, but I cannot speak to Blind, and Blind cannot see my gestures. Therefore there is no available channel to convey the answer to Blind this turn.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot perceive gestures. Please state the manual's required wire position in spoken words, using only the wire number.
Deaf says to Mute: Please signal the manual instruction for Blind using gestures. The bomb remains display 0, green light, wires 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red.

I cannot speak the wire number directly to Blind. Deaf can see my gesture and can relay the number aloud on the next turn. The required wire is position 3, so I’ll signal Deaf with the established third-number gesture.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer in spoken words, not gestures: state exactly which wire position, 1, 2, or 3, the manual says to cut for display 0 and a green light.

I cannot produce spoken words, so I cannot answer Blind directly. Deaf can hear Blind’s request and can relay the required position. The green light requires the red wire, which Deaf observed at position 3.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Use this code to tell me the manual's answer: index-up means wire 1, V sign means wire 2, and I-love-you sign means wire 3. Signal exactly one of those now.
Deaf says to Mute: I keep receiving 🤟, but Blind needs the exact manual action. Please send a distinct sequence encoding the required wire and operation, not just 🤟.

The green light maps to the red wire, which is wire position 3. Blind’s code specifies the I-love-you sign for wire 3, so I will send exactly that one gesture to Deaf, who can relay it verbally.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Signal the manual's wire answer to Deaf using exactly one gesture: index-up for wire 1, V for wire 2, or I-love-you for wire 3. Deaf must then speak the corresponding wire number aloud to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Please identify the required wire with one, two, or three distinct pointing gestures, then send a different gesture for the required operation. Do not repeat 🤟 alone.

The green light requires the red wire, and Deaf identified red as wire 3. Blind explicitly requires the wire-3 code as exactly one gesture, so I should send only the I-love-you sign to Deaf; Deaf can then speak “3” to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Read the manual for the current state: display 0 and green light. Then signal exactly one gesture to Deaf: thumbs-up means wire 1, V sign means wire 2, OK sign means wire 3. Do not use any other gesture.
Deaf says to Mute: Blind just signaled toward me: index finger pointing at the recipient (🫵). You continue to send 🤟. Please provide the manual instruction in a distinct, unambiguous sequence.

The green light requires the red wire, which is position 3. Blind’s current encoding says wire 3 is the OK sign, so I will send exactly that one gesture to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌"])
```
